test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All golds are hens.

No hen is a cow.

**Conclusions:**

(I) No gold is a cow.

(II) Some cows are hens.
solution:
**Statements:**

All golds are hens.

No hen is a cow.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76f40ea1a6eb2c0741827699483be30cb6ca6688c4ca5927335b4cad1de0cb09.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) No gold is a cow. - Follow (Because, all golds are hens and no hen is a cow, which means no gold is a cow.)

(II) Some cows are hens. - Does not follow (Because, no hen is a cow, so some cows are not hens.)

Thus, only conclusion (I) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".
